title: Credential among long credential-free filler
description: A reviewed base credential placed at the head, middle or tail of a long filler, or repeated, or beside a second distinct credential.
semantics: The filler holds no credential, so every secret span is a placed base value; each occurrence is its own expected span.

applicability.rationale: Placement is independent of the family.

evidenceBasis.rationale: A placed documented-grammar value is the credential wherever it sits; project policy of this example.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016).
